learning_outcomes.text: Develop competencies related to structural analysis and kinematic analysis of mechanisms as well as the synthesis of gear mechanisms.
Assimilate knowledge related to the development of general applications in engineering.

syllabus_topics: Kinematic analysis of bar and wheel mechanisms
Applications related to the structure of mechanisms
Applications related to the kinematic analysis of wheel mechanisms
Applications related to the synthesis of cylindrical gears
teaching_methods: Combined teaching using whiteboard and PowerPoint with video projector

assessment_methods.method: Course Exam (covering Structure, Kinematics, Gear Synthesis)
Seminar Activities (problem solving and short tests)
Laboratory Activities (grid test and practical work performance)

assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must obtain a passing grade in at least two out of three chapters from the exam. The sum of the averages of these two passed chapters, divided by three, must be at least 5.
